sourceReview.conclusion: 三项成本冷却双来源和逐级数组一致；普通登记可复用，均不添加施法时长。

cast.maokai_r: 只有spellTotalTime1，不能反推开始施法时长

sourceReview.boundary: 根缺少弹药/再次施放/引导或急速开关不等于false；三项都有mCantCancelWhileWindingUp=true，未独立证明游戏所有取消失败时序与冷却起点。

officialSingleUseShape.description: Ruptures the ground at target location, popping enemy units into the air, dealing damage and slowing them.
officialSingleUseShape.tooltip: Cho'Gath ruptures the ground, <status>Knocking Up</status> enemies for {{ e5 }} second, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagetooltip }} magic damage</magicDamage>, and <status>Slowing</status> them by {{ e2 }}% for {{ e3 }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialSingleUseShape.description: Braum slams the ground, knocking up enemies nearby and in a line in front of him. A fissure is left along the line that slows enemies.
officialSingleUseShape.tooltip:
Braum slams the ground sending forth a fissure that Knocks Up enemies in its path and nearby Braum, and deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage. The first target hit is Knocked Up for between {{ minknockup }} and {{ maxknockup }} seconds, increasing with distance from Braum. All others hit are Knocked Up for {{ minknockup }} seconds.

The fissure also creates a zone for {{ slowzoneduration }} seconds, that Slows by {{ movespeedmod }}%.
{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

officialSingleUseShape.description: Maokai summons a colossal wall of brambles and thorns that slowly advances forwards, damaging and rooting any enemies in the path.
officialSingleUseShape.tooltip: Maokai summons a colossal wave of brambles and thorns, <status>Rooting</status> enemies for {{ minrootduration }} to {{ maxrootduration }} seconds, increasing with distance travelled, and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. Hitting a champion gives Maokai <speed>{{ movehaste*100 }}% Move Speed</speed>, decaying over {{ hasteduration }} seconds. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

rootDecision.scope: 已接受的普通主动使用登记，复用现有成本冷却过程；不表示完整施放时序或失败取消退款已经核定。
rootDecision.basis: 沿已批准科加斯W同类证据：官方maxammo=-1、vars为空、根绑定及正文为单次释放，未出现第二施放；固定普通成本冷却一致且本批未新增引导或弹药机制。PROCESS_START是该普通使用登记的管理起点。
remaining: 完整施法时序及取消失败特殊情形
实际伤害、击飞、禁锢、减速、随距离变化和移速衰减等各原分支
rootDecision.reviewFocus: 若有具体证据表明某项普通冷却不是该次已接受使用时开始，则该项cooldown改为空，仅登记已证成本；不以说明文字近似不同起点。
rootDecision.sourceFollowup: 针对冷却起点额外追问的代理轮次在服务繁忙时中断；根依据原始来源结论及科加斯W现存独立结论形成上述待审取舍，不冒充追加评审通过。
